card.name: Words pointing to a future event
card.fires_on: Words right after a subject that look ahead to a future or possible outcome, such as will, could, likely to, waiting to, or expect. Fires on the auxiliary or verb that begins the predicted event.

modes.label: Future auxiliary
modes.description: The word will or a following be/potentially in a prediction about what a device or technology will do.
modes.example: scientists worldwide. By 2015, laserlike x-ray flashes that enable new insights into the nanoworld will<< be>> generated in the tunnels

modes.label: Likelihood phrases
modes.description: Verbs or particles completing phrases like waiting to happen or likely to die.
modes.example: Clearly this company has an age discrimination suit waiting to<< happen>>.

modes.label: Hypothetical or expected
modes.description: Words in conditional or expectation clauses about what will be the case.
modes.example: If this were real<<,>> I would be wearing a bulky spacesuit
